summary.text: The bill would require federal courts to automatically issue lifetime no-contact orders prohibiting defendants convicted of violent crimes or sex crimes from contacting their victims, unless the court specifically terminates or suspends the order. These orders would take effect at sentencing and remain in place for the defendant's lifetime, with no fees charged to victims.
